title: TEMPEST: 1024x768 @ 60 Hz screen leakage
description: Synthetic unintended video emanation of a 1024x768 @ 60 Hz display (a test pattern of luma bars, a checkerboard and UI panels) at 2.4 MHz around 520 MHz - the 8th harmonic of the 65 MHz pixel clock - with the leaking device at array bearing 35 deg. Expect the decoder to auto-detect '1024x768 @ 60 Hz', show a reconstructed picture in its video panel, and (coherent mode with DoA on) a 'screen' talker near 35 deg in the DF panel. 3 s, looped.

title: TEMPEST: 3840x2160 @ 60 Hz (4K) screen leakage
description: Synthetic unintended video emanation of a 3840x2160 @ 60 Hz (4K UHD) display at 2.4 MHz around 594 MHz - the pixel-clock fundamental (594 MHz) - with the leaking device at array bearing 35 deg. The mode is FORCED here (at 2.4 MHz the 4K line rate aliases with lower modes under Auto detect, since only ~18 samples span a line). The host compresses the reconstructed picture to WebP, so a 4K frame (8.29M pixels) crosses the wire in ~19 KB. Expect the decoder to report 'Detected 3840x2160 @ 60 Hz', show a reconstructed picture, and a 'screen' talker near 35 deg. 2 s, looped. 4K reconstruction is CPU- and memory-heavy - a Pi manages only a low frame rate.
